name: Dark Americana / weird fiction short story series

mentions.name: Dark Americana / weird fiction short story series
mentions.description: A series of pulpy short stories in a Dark Americana / weird fiction vein, mixing noir, magic, existential dread, and horror; written as practice to iron out writing shortcomings and stretch new muscles before tackling a novel in a different genre.
mentions.source_excerpt: A series of pulpy short stories, sort of a Dark Americana / weird fiction thing. Noir, magic, existential dread, horror. Warming up for a novel in a completely different genre but I wanted to iron out some of my own shortcomings and stretch some muscles before I write yet another 100k words on a project I'm unhappy with.
